arguments.content: P1 review pattern: delayed or replayed cleanup can invalidate a newer resource even when all operations are serialized. Distinguish the stable resource key (workspace) from the operation that owns the current association (setup ID); cleanup by stable key alone can revoke a later successful setup. Verify failure -> another setup completes -> delayed cleanup -> unchanged reader, and cleanup -> replacement -> replay. Preserve owner-based deletion even when the pending record is already absent: successful completion may remove pending before cleanup of its own association. In this workspace review (HEAD a7ab15e9fc17243d0f00288ca01907dd06dcdb73 -> staged cleanup.py blob f716353505d7450510029a979109df2b9fb036b2), both existing tests passed, but direct HEAD/index reproductions showed active_connection returning None only in the candidate for delayed cleanup and replay after reuse. Restore the association setup_id equality guard and test the serialized lifecycle; concurrency mechanisms are unnecessary for this contract.
